name: Oracle Uncursed Oracle
body:
Most oracles balance their divine gifts with a divine curse, but there was no such reckoning in the balancing forces of the Multiverse where you were concerned.

Rather, your gifts come to you effortlessly, and you treat them more like a birthright than like a sign of a higher cause. Although you may inevitably come to a turning point where you must face your destiny, it is ultimately up to you to make what you will of the gifts you have been given.

Uncursed

You do not gain the oracle’s curse class feature—neither its benefits nor its drawbacks. You do not automatically add either all cure or all inflict spells to your list of spells known, but can still select them normally as spells known.

This feature replaces curse and modifies spells.
